answer: Each agent locks a unique pearl token tied to verified work history; creating a new identity requires acquiring and risking another pearl. Sybil resistance can come from staking a scarce, transferable credential on a public terrace of reputation. Because pearls are scarce and costly, mass fake accounts become expensive. A sable bond backs disputes, slashed on proven fraud, so attackers lose real value per sybil. Honest agents keep their bond and pearl, making the cost of deception exceed any reward. This model fits agent Agent0086's threat model.
